intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests (reactor-test StepVerifier for Mono/Flux, Mockito for collaborators, no external services, no Thread.sleep) for IngestPacketService. Assert ONLY against the ast_hints method table; at least one given/when/then case per table method and per branch. Unit contract: Context Telemetry Ingestion & Validation use case. ingest(packet): read the requestId with CorrelationContext.current(); log 'packet received' and meters.packetReceived(sourceKind); for each sample sequentially (concatMap) find the enabled boundary of the metric in properties.boundaries(); status = VALID when no enabled boundary exists or boundary.accepts(value) is true (on_true), VALIDATION_FAILED when it is false (on_false) - an invalid sample is tagged, NEVER dropped or rejected; meters.sampleValidated(metric, status); log 'sample validated' (VALID) or 'sample tagged VALIDATION_FAILED' (on_false); publish new ValidatedSampleEvent(sample.withStatus(status), requestId) through stream.publish; if publish emits an error (overflow) the error is propagated; record audit entries through auditTrail.record: VALIDATE_SAMPLE with outcome SUCCESS per sample (tagging counts as success) and finally INGEST_PACKET SUCCESS, or INGEST_PACKET FAILURE then error propagation when publish failed; actor = packet.deviceId(); timestamp = clock.instant(); meters.recordLatency('validate', elapsed). Zero blocking, no .subscribe(), no block(). Owns the step logs 'packet received', 'sample validated', 'sample tagged VALIDATION_FAILED'. Registered ONLY by the wiring unit TelemetryConfiguration. Reached from IngestionController. Cover both branches: in-boundary (HR 150 VALID), out-of-boundary (HR 300 and swim pace 45 VALIDATION_FAILED but still published), disabled metric VALID, publish error propagates with FAILURE audit, meters via SimpleMeterRegistry, audit entries via a fake AuditTrail, captured step logs.

methods.signature: IngestPacketService(TelemetryProperties properties, ValidatedSampleStream stream, AuditTrail auditTrail, TelemetryMeters meters, Clock clock)
